system.description: This item looks like a fancy helmet. The wearer of this helm may send messages, by mere thought, to any creature within 90'. The creature receiving the thought messages will understand them. (The creature may refuse to respond.) The wearer may also read the thoughts of a living creature within range. To make the helm work, the wearer must concentrate on the creature, and he may not move or cast spells. If the creature fails a saving throw vs. spells (or permits the thought reading), the wearer will understand the creature's thoughts.
system.unidentifiedDesc: A fancy helm made of some type of metal.
